parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the suitcase, made of durable plastic material. It is an arched component attached to the top of the suitcase.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to carry or lift the suitcase comfortably. It provides a secure grip for transportation.
parts.Movement_description: The handle may pivot or fold down slightly depending on the suitcase design, but generally remains fixed during use.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the suitcase, made of polycarbonate material. It forms the storage compartment for belongings.
parts.Functional_description: The base body provides structural integrity and storage space for items. It protects contents from external impacts.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is a rigid, non-moving part that serves as the main container of the suitcase.
